values: Ten Florals V2 — Stock-Basis Repair & CF-01 Admission

A real parser defect was repaired: ten diluted working stocks were encoded as fraction 1.0 across 32 formula-row uses. Formula geometry and formula hashes were not changed. All 545 rows now have a known fraction and basis for planned computational active-equivalence arithmetic. Twenty-five row uses still have unknown carrier identity. CF-01 is the first pilot candidate because all 56 of its rows have complete fraction, basis, and carrier lineage. Physical units remain withheld until 56 ExactStockRefs and all noncomputational gates pass.
